request.style: English, gentle folk storytelling, male vocal with soft female harmony, fingerpicked guitar, accordion, cello, light percussion, warm and wry, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jonah walked through Nineveh, three days wide and tall
He shouted forty days and then your city's going to fall
The king came down from his throne and sat down in the dust
And the whole great city turned around, they put away their lust
Oh, Nineveh, that great city

[Verse]
When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way
He relented from the disaster and he spared them on that day
But Jonah was displeased with it and angry as could be
He said I knew you'd spare them, LORD, now take my life from me
Oh, Nineveh, that great city

[Verse]
He went and sat outside the town to see what would befall
The LORD God made a leafy plant to shade him from it all
But in the night a worm came by, the plant was dead by day
The sun beat down on Jonah's head, he wished to pass away
Oh, Nineveh, that great city

[Verse]
And God said, Jonah, is it right for you to be so sore
You pitied this one little plant you did not labor for
Should I not care for all those souls, a hundred twenty thousand strong
Who don't know right hand from the left, and the cattle all along
Oh, Nineveh, that great city
